definitions.accuracy_percent: raw endpoint accuracy fraction multiplied by 100
definitions.hardware: seeds 281 and 307 A100; the other 10 seeds 4090D; no time aggregation
definitions.inference: descriptive only; no winner selection, A/B adjudication, intervals, or hypothesis tests
definitions.pair_mean_sd: arithmetic mean and sample SD of 12 same-seed paired differences
definitions.paired_difference_pp: same-seed target slot accuracy percent minus reference slot accuracy percent
definitions.reference_scope: each of 16 target slots versus every one of 15 non-replay reference slots; self-pairs included
definitions.sample_sd: sample standard deviation across 12 seeds, denominator n-1
definitions.slot16: donor-dependent same-seed slot3 quota replay; not independent deployable method
definitions.slot_mean: unweighted arithmetic mean across the 12 fixed seeds
definitions.wins_ties_losses: counts by exact sign of the unrounded paired difference; ties equal zero
